name: Notice Period
text: The Employee or Employer may terminate this Agreement by providing written notice for the period specified herein or salary in lieu of such notice, subject to applicable law.

legal_basis.note: Conditions precedent to retrenchment — notice or wages in lieu
Notice of dismissal under standing orders, where Chapter IV applies
Notice period for shop and commercial establishment employees. State legislation, NOT repealed.

invalid_if: Notice period is waived contrary to statutory requirements
source: Industrial Relations Code, 2020; State Shops and Establishments Acts
title: Notice Period

jurisdiction_constraints.general: IDA 1947 minimum notice = 1 month for workmen; Shops Acts vary state-by-state
jurisdiction_constraints.Karnataka: Karnataka Shops Act notice periods apply to shop employees
jurisdiction_constraints.Maharashtra: Maharashtra Shops Act 1948 S.66 notice obligations apply

dispute_hotspots: Notice buyout — company refuses PILON and forces employee to serve — labour court jurisdiction
Garden leave validity — employee challenges productivity obligation during garden leave
Abscondment — employee leaves without notice — recovery of PILON/training bond
authoring_note: LABOUR CODES, 21 NOVEMBER 2025. The four labour Codes were brought into force on 21 November 2025, repealing the 29 central labour statutes this clause previously cited. The Delhi Shops and Establishments Act, 1954 reference has been generalised to state legislation, since the applicable state Act depends on the operating state and none of them are repealed by the Codes. The retrenchment notice and compensation figures under IRC s.70 were not individually verified.
